text: read /tmp/handoff-20260701-224548-parts-weld-together-edits-bleed-across-coincident-parts.md and then to stack up onto this task is to hoist in the glb/obj imports through the project file explorer menu as well as clearing out this project file explorer from mocked data/hookup and giving it real functionality. All of these tasks are straight forward some requiring more attention to detail than others all equally as important
resolution: Project File Explorer de-mocked and given real functionality: the dialog now runs on a live disk index (listDir/stat over cart/editor, cart/hmsc-int, runtime, framework, tools, docs; loud 800-file cap; rescan button), and GLB/OBJ import is hoisted through it — opening a .glb/.obj row opens a real model document through the native __mesh_load_file importer, plus a new File > Import Model (Ctrl+I) zenity picker for files anywhere on disk. Fabricated file records, seed history, and invented preview stats are gone; previews show real size/modified/format.
